source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第一、二节

textbook_summary: V1/V2 rS and no initial q at integer microvolt output.
R increases V1-V5, V6 lower than V5.
S deepest V2 and decreases V2-V6.
V3 R/S approximately one with substantial positive and negative waves.
V1/V2 R peak within 30 ms; V5/V6 within 50 ms.
Small initial q allowed V4-V6, duration/depth constrained.
scope: Project-authored shared early/main/terminal depolarization components; not independently validated adult preset
construction: RA/LA/RL/LL retain original QRS weights. Chest potential = shared limb mean + independent early/main/terminal components before standard projection. Offline exact fractions, one Q32 rounding per electrode. Residual chest projection quantization <= half Q32 unit.
authorship: Numeric component amplitudes and node locations are project choices within textbook qualitative constraints, not traced textbook data
